summary_en: NGK Corporation raised interim dividend to 63 yen per share from 53 yen forecast, and revised full-year dividend forecast to 126 yen from 106 yen, reflecting stronger-than-expected earnings driven by business performance and yen weakness.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Revision (Interim and Year-End Dividends) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
On 30 October 2026, NGK Corporation's Board of Directors approved an increase in the interim dividend for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2027. The interim dividend per share was raised to 63 yen from the previously forecast 53 yen, effective 2 December 2026. The company simultaneously revised its full-year dividend forecast to 126 yen per share, up from the prior forecast of 106 yen.

The interim dividend represents a 10 yen per-share increase, bringing total year-to-date distributions to 126 yen. The company's dividend policy targets a consolidated payout ratio of 35 percent or higher over a three-year period based on ROE, alongside a net asset dividend rate of approximately 3.5 percent. Cash flow prospects are also considered in allocating returns to shareholders.

The revision reflects stronger-than-expected first-half performance, driven by improved business conditions and favorable effects from yen weakness. Full-year earnings guidance has also been raised above the company's previous outlook, supporting the increased dividend commitment. The company positions sustained shareholder returns and capital allocation as key elements of its strategy to enhance enterprise value.
